What this could include

The website and the booking side, together.

Enough custom functionality to remove the repetitive admin, without putting The Yoga Garden into an oversized monthly booking platform.

Clients

Booking & My Garden

  • Profiles and contact information
  • Digital waiver status
  • Live class availability
  • Self-service booking and cancellation
  • Automated cancellation list offers
Studio

Owner & coach dashboard

  • Rosters and class capacity
  • Waiver status
  • Cash and e-transfer tracking
  • Attendance
  • Class management
Optional later

Room to grow

  • Online payment
  • Class passes or packages
  • Memberships
  • Gift cards
  • Additional reporting
Concept pricing

Two ways to approach it.

Final scope and pricing would be confirmed before production work begins.

Booking system + portal$2,600Built to work alongside the current website.
Website + complete booking system$3,400Custom website, booking, client portal, owner and coach dashboards.
Ongoing costs

The production system can be designed around infrastructure with free usage levels that should comfortably support The Yoga Garden at its current size. There is no required monthly hosting or maintenance package in this concept. Launch support is included, and future changes can be quoted only when they’re actually needed.
